page.content:
Hollow-one warlock-sorcerer hung in Whitestone and walked back.

How Laudna connects

  • Faction: Bells Hells — Laudna is the hollow-one warlock of Bells Hells.
  • Character: Marisha Ray — Marisha Ray plays Laudna.
  • Character: Imogen Temult — Imogen and Laudna are the paired heart of Bells Hells.
  • Location: Whitestone — Laudna was hanged in Whitestone and still carries that city's ghost.

What is Laudna?

Laudna is Marisha Ray's Campaign 3 warlock, a Whitestone hanging victim carrying Delilah Briarwood's shadow, Imogen's partner, and Bells Hells' longest ghost.

Key threads lead to Bells Hells, Marisha Ray, Imogen Temult and Whitestone.
